We need to see if class 1 iff x0>0. Compute hidden activations: h0 = ReLU(1*x0+0*x1)=ReLU(x0). h1=ReLU(-1*x0+0*x1)=ReLU(-x0). h2=ReLU(0*x0+1*x1)=ReLU(x1). h3=ReLU(0*x0-1*x1)=ReLU(-x1). Output logits: y0 = -1*h0 +1*h1 -4*h2 +4*h3. y1 = 1*h0 -1*h1 +4*h2 -4*h3. We want argmax class 1 when x0>0 regardless of x1. Let's analyze.

Case x0>0: h0=x0, h1=0. Then y0 = -x0 -4*h2 +4*h3. y1 = x0 +4*h2 -4*h3. So y1 - y0 = 2x0 +8*h2 -8*h3. Since x0>0, first term positive. h2=ReLU(x1), h3=ReLU(-x1). For any x1, h2-h3 = x1? Actually if x1>0: h2=x1, h3=0 => diff = x1. If x1<0: h2=0, h3=-x1 => diff = -x1. So 8*(h2-h3)=8*|x1|. So y1 - y0 = 2x0 +8|x1| >0. So class1 wins. Good.

Case x0<0: h0=0, h1=-x0. Then y0 = 0 + (-x0)*1 -4*h2 +4*h3 = -x0 -4*h2 +4*h3. y1 = 0 -(-x0) +4*h2 -4*h3 = x0 +4*h2 -4*h3. y1 - y0 = (x0 +4h2 -4h3) - (-x0 -4h2 +4h3)= 2x0 +8h2 -8h3 = 2x0 +8(h2-h3). Since x0<0, 2x0 negative. h2-h3 = |x1
